title: Lifesteal Market
description: This is a item tracking mod for Lifesteal.net. You can compare prices better with it.
body:
This is **Lifesteal Market** a mod that tracks the econemy of lifestel.net in real time
track items track any items value by typing /stock ingame and using the search bar at the top ![click on this search bar and search for any item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8eae711167b1c15a33ca17464a44405b1bb2c07.png) ![this shows the graph if you search for an item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e3ead157ad0bcb5fc50123db3962407ebf4ebf6.png)
compare items compare 2 or more items by searching for them on the rigth side ![this is the compare search bar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8e98b72e88322d903fa92def58d81acd72a2814.png)
livetime item notifications get a notification on discord by linking your account or get the notification ingame by clicking this button when youre on a item page ![price alert](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6544589c243d3c15f991b282e608eda0c2c0c6e4.png)
networth check your true networth using /networth ![your networth](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee7edc926fa8729328cf87c409fad381eea046e8.png)
leaderboard check other players networth and climb the leaderboard by clicking on the leaderboards button in the top right ![leaderboard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a047ed0a19e0550d1b4d9ce1ce6c951dccc246b.png)
please check our patreon because we need to pay for a server host that stores all the data.
